unverified: Nocatee's golf cart map (nocatee.com/golfcartmap) shows which paths and multi-use trails are signed for carts; only paths tagged golf_cart in OpenStreetMap are drawn. Greenway trails that aren't tagged are left off. Check the signs.
Most Nocatee streets have no posted limit in OpenStreetMap; untagged local streets are shown green (assumed), not verified.
Only ELECTRIC golf carts are covered by the Nocatee ordinances; gas carts aren't.

bans.label: CR 210 / Nocatee Parkway: 45-55 mph freeway and arterial
I-95 / SR 9B: limited-access, carts and LSVs barred

Cross Town Dr: multilane divided road, golf carts cross only at cart crossings (Jacksonville Ord. 2017-66, Jax Daily Record 2017); rest of the road posted 40 mph (Mapillary, FDOT TDA); no posted 25 found
Crosswater Pkwy: Nocatee's main north-south road, neighbouring pieces posted 35-45 mph (Mapillary, FDOT TDA); no posted 25 found, so not shown as golf-cart legal

speed_names.label: Valley Ridge Blvd posted 45 mph; golf carts not allowed in the street, cart crossings only (Artisan Lakes at Nocatee HOA, Nov 2022; AARoads; Jacksonville Ord. 2017-66)

enforcement.note: Golf carts: Nocatee roads posted 25 or less (region rule max_posted 25), signed 10 ft+ cart paths, designated 16 ft+ multi-use trails at 15 mph, not sidewalks. LSVs: state rule, posted 35 or less. US 1, SR A1A, CR 210 / Nocatee Pkwy, I-95 / SR 9B banned; Valley Ridge Blvd 45 mph. The Nocatee cart/trail map is an image we haven't digitized, so trail coverage relies on OSM golf_cart tags. No separate St. Johns Sheriff LSV road map was found.
